verdict.rationale: Browserbase advertises session-level observability (logs, live view, session replay) and has a dashboard for creating and optimizing agents. None of the evidence documents a real-time dashboard showing system metrics or browser-pool and concurrency status. Session live view is an adjacent feature, not pool or system monitoring, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monitor live system metrics and worker/browser pool status through a real-time dashboard
